app_fee.value: International graduate applicants pay a $65 USD application fee, though Rowan Global Ph.D. program checklists note no application fee is required for several Ph.D. programs and NACES evaluation holders receive a fee waiver.
app_fee.quote: Submit your International Graduate application and pay $65 (USD) application fee.

fee_waiver.value: International applicants who already have an official foreign credential evaluation from a NACES member provider and submit it during application receive an application fee waiver.
fee_waiver.quote: Looking for a waiver? If you already have a foreign credential evaluation from a provider who is a member of NACES, and you submit an official copy during the application process, we will waive the application fee and offer you the opportunity to apply to Rowan free of charge.

gre_general.value: The university-wide international graduate admissions page does not state a single GRE General policy; individual departments set their own GRE rules.

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL iBT score for Traditional Admissions is 4 on the new scale effective January 21, 2026 (70 on the legacy 0-120 iBT scale).
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL iBT: minimum score of 70 for Traditional Admissions ... Effective January 21st, 2026: minimum score of 4 for Traditional Admissions.

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS Academic overall band score for Traditional Admissions is 6.0 (IELTS One Skill Retake is accepted).
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: minimum score of 6.0 for Traditional Admissions

english_waiver.value: English test exemptions apply only to degrees from the U.S. or countries on Rowan's official English-exempt country list; India is not listed, so Indian applicants must submit an English proficiency score.
english_waiver.quote: They have obtained a degree from an institution in the United States (US) or a country where English is the official language and the medium of instruction. | The following countries have English as their official language and the language of instruction and are exempt from English language testing requirements | Antigua and Barbuda ... Trinidad and Tobago

notes: Public Carnegie R2 research university in Glassboro and Stratford/Camden, New Jersey. Note on application fee: international-graduate-students/index.html, phd_me.html, and phd-mse.pdf state $65 (USD), international-policies/index.html specifies $65.00 (USD) for '(masters coursework-only applicants)', and several global.rowan.edu/programs/phd-in-*.html checklists state 'No application fee required'. No standalone Ph.D. in Physics, Astronomy, Mathematics, or Statistics; Environmental Science is MS-only (Civil & Environmental Engineering Ph.D. covers environment).
